messages.en: No but
Because of practice,
April Fools' Day
I couldn't enjoy it!!!!!
I was going to come before midnight,
but I only just got off work now...
I kept thinking
about what kind of prank I should pull...
But are you really looking forward to this concert?
I'm going to look really pretty,
so look forward to it and wait for me.
Ah, saying things like 'it's going to be legendary' is kind of embarrassing. ㅎㅎ
헤헿
Hayeon, April Fools' Day is over.
Wanna fight?!
Come up on stage.
My right-hand sleeping pill has had plenty of rest.
Oh right.
That drawing I made of Seoyeon unnie...
You said it was lawsuit-worthy?
Like defamation or insulting someone's character?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅇ
No but,
after having my 'Painter Jeong' title taken away,
I got so depressed that I stopped drawing, and now my skills have regressed.
Don't be depressed, just go 'wooong' instead.
우웅ㅇ웅웅우융ㅇ루융웅ㅇ!
Actually, here's something funny.
Today, the members
kept saying,
"Why are you so handsome?" all throughout practice.
It made me feel proud.
Ah... was it because it was April Fools' Day...?
Was I the only one who didn't realize?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅌㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
But today,
if Y/n had seen me,
I think you would've really liked it.
I'm really looking forward to the concert.
I'm even more nervous than for the other concerts.
You'll have to find me well.
?? Did you save yourself a seat in the audience?
Yeah, yeah. I'm going to watch it from the audience with everyone else.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
It's really just around the corner.
I'm going to be kind of like a fairy? A fairy stone? Luna?
I'll be moving all over the place.
So make sure you catch me.
따따단단던
ㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
I'm back at the dorm now.
I'm going to wash up and go straight to sleep.
Tell me you love me~
I love you more~
Haranghae ❤️
